{{Youmay|the social class on Alegra II|[[Flotsam (starship)|''Flotsam'']], a Starhawk Shuttle; or [[Flotsam]], a planet}}
The '''Flotsam''' were the lowest social class on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Algara II]]. They were [[Algarian (race)|Algarians]] who were beggars or unemployed, or those considered to be insane.
